name: meeting-intelligence
description: Turn meeting audio, STT transcripts, or notes into transcripts, summaries, decisions, action items, follow-up drafts, and optional briefing assets.

interface.shortDescription: Create structured meeting packages from audio, STT, or notes.
interface.longDescription: Meeting Intelligence helps turn meeting audio, existing STT transcripts, or meeting notes into a durable transcript, concise summary, decisions, action items, follow-up draft, verification note, and optional TTS briefing plan. It keeps privacy gates explicit and reuses prior STT outputs before starting new transcription work.
defaultPrompt: Turn this transcript into summary and action items.
Find existing STT output before summarizing this audio.
Draft a follow-up message from these meeting notes.
